en: This is the spot.
But we can't start fishing without any{SAUT}bait.
We'll need some bugs.{PAGE}I'm sure we'll find more than enough if{SAUT}we look among the leaves. Let's go see.
This is it! I can sense them!
Well, we got our bait. Let's find that fish!{PAGE}You got this, Senpai!
Bet Joker catches it first!
What's that!?
Fine, then, it's a duel! Show 'em what{SAUT}you got, Joker!
Leave it to me.{OPTION}Time to finish what we started.{OPTION}Don't drag me into this.
Hm. Let's do it.
C'mon, it'll be fun.
You can do it, Sensei!
Go, Joker! Show us your brilliance!
I knew this would happen.
All right. Ready... Go!
Hm!
Guess we'll have to wait. It usually{SAUT}takes a while from this point...
...I've got a bite!
Are you kidding me!?
The way the line's pulling, it's gonna{SAUT}be a big one!
Ugh... This thing's about to take me{SAUT}down with it...
I've got your back.{OPTION}We'll do it together.
Joker... Right!{PAGE}Ready? One... Two...
Three!{OPTION}Got you!
Whoa! That's hella huge...
Judging by the size, I'm sure this is the{SAUT}fish we're looking for.
Whew... Thanks. It was supposed to be a{SAUT}duel, but you still stepped in to help me.
I did what any leader would do.{OPTION}We're a team.
Our leader...{PAGE}You're right. I would've done the same{SAUT}thing.
A team... Yeah, you're right!
There was like, a clashing of powers,{SAUT}and a fusion thing that was so intense!
You two were able to catch the fish{SAUT}because you worked together.
Yes, it was quite the battle.{PAGE}Well now, I'd say we're done here.{SAUT}Let's head back.
